description: Circle of Peace Druids are healers and diplomats, using the power of nature to protect and pacify.

features.name: Emboldening Bond
features.description: You can bond with a number of willing creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier. They gain temporary hit points and advantage on saving throws.

features.name: Protective Magic
features.description: When you cast a spell that requires a saving throw, creatures you've bonded with have advantage on that save.

features.name: Healing Circle
features.description: As an action, you can restore hit points to all bonded creatures within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Universal Peace
features.description: Creatures within 30 feet of you have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures bonded with you.
